text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeeek!? I-I'm sorry, I'm so sorryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? I haven't even said anything yet.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyah?! S-Sowwy! It was just a reflex...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"U-Umm... technically, today is my 
birthday, you see..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
With so many people coming all the way to 
celebrate for me... I'm starting to feel 
quite overwhelmed...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Listen here. They're just showin' up 
and celebratin' on their own anyway, so 
just brush 'em off however you want.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you get all stiff and formal, it's just 
gonna annoy the person celebrating ya. 
Just give 'em a casual thank-you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
R-Right... Naturally, smoothly... I'll do 
my besht...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And, happy birthday to ya.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Are you even listenin' to me, you 
bastard!?
